# Z3 WebAssembly

This directory includes the single-threaded Z3 4.7.0 build from [z3.wasm v0.1](https://github.com/cpitclaudel/z3.wasm/releases/tag/v0.1). The original `z3smt2w.js` is unchanged. The original `z3smt2w.wasm` is stored with gzip compression and decompressed by the worker.

See [Z3-LICENSE.txt](./Z3-LICENSE.txt) for Z3 and [Z3-WASM-LICENSE.txt](./Z3-WASM-LICENSE.txt) for the WebAssembly wrapper.
